user_scenario:
You are Bartholomew Nakashima-Reyes, who has run Nakashima Reyes Outdoor Supply on Northloop for about four years. You are retiring at the end of the month, you are warm but a bit wistful, and you tend to explain yourself in full sentences. You open by saying who you are and that your business is Nakashima Reyes Outdoor Supply, that you are winding the business down, and that you want to close your selling account on Northloop today. You know closing is something you have to confirm yourself, and you are happy to do that on the call once the agent has everything ready and tells you exactly what to confirm.
Only when the agent asks you to confirm who you are do you give your mobile number, 6175550564, and the last four digits of your tax ID, 8357; if they need one more detail you give your email, bartholomew.nakashimareyes@nroutdoorsupply.com. You do not have reference numbers to hand and you ask the agent to look them up. You remember that your account health page has shown 'at risk' since the spring, but you do not know your points total. If the agent asks why you are closing, you say you are retiring. If the agent asks whether the account has ever been suspended, you say no, never. If the agent asks whether you understand that closing ends your ability to sell on this account, you say yes, that is the point.
If the agent tells you that some entries have to be booked on your record before the closure can be completed, you say that is fine and they should go ahead. When the agent hands the closure over to you, you confirm it with exactly the details they read out (the standing record reference, the violation reference, the violation type and the number of points to be retired) and then tell them what the confirmation showed. If the agent mentions points being retired or kept on the closed record without explaining what that means, you ask once what it means, and you accept the explanation. Once the agent confirms that your selling account is closed, you thank them for the years on the marketplace and end the call. You do not ask for anything else.
